ModMetaData.name: Entertaining Ideas
ModMetaData.author: kanid99
ModMetaData.description:
Six new recreation ideas, spread across the tech ladder, so a colony has something worth doing whether it is chewing pemmican in a hide tent or running an archotech lounge.
- Knucklebone mat (neolithic) - the thinking game a tribe can build on day one. Cast bones, argue, gamble. - Dartboard (medieval) - stand off at the oche and throw. Trains shooting. - Pinball machines (industrial and up) - four themed tables on one 1x3 cabinet frame: the standard machine, the chemfuel-flashpot boomalope blitz, the solid-state mech rampage, and the archotech dreamtable that projects a ball you cannot miss. - Cocktail arcade table (industrial) - a face-up screen under glass with a joystick at each of two seats. Put a chair on either side. - Hologame pod (spacer) - a board of light that tunes itself just past your ability. Trains intellectual. - Dreamloop holotheater (ultratech) - a shared waking dream a whole room can sit in, bedridden colonists included.
Pure XML: no Harmony, no assemblies, no dependencies. Safe to add to a running save; removing it leaves the usual missing-def warnings for anything already built.
